name: x-insight-monitor
description: X 大V监控、翻译、逻辑分析、事实核查与企业微信推送桌面应用
author: X Insight Monitor

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist/main/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist: npm run build:collector && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:collector && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:collector && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
